description: The plot illustrates relative change (in percent) across grouped model layer ranges for four configurations labeled in the legend. The x-axis is categorical with five tick labels—“Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32”—spaced evenly. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, −10%, and −15%, spanning roughly from about +5% at the top to about −15% at the bottom; a horizontal dashed reference line is drawn at 0%. The yellow line with circular markers (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) starts near 0% at Layer1-4, is around −1% at Layer5-12, returns to about 0% at Layer13-20, sits slightly below 0% at Layer21-28, and ends slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The light-blue line with circular markers (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) begins near 0% at Layer1-4, drops to about −3% at Layer5-12, reaches about −6% at Layer13-20, rises to about −4% at Layer21-28, and ends near −1% at Layer29-32. The red line with square markers (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) starts slightly above 0% at Layer1-4, moves to about −2.5% at Layer5-12, is around −2% at Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and finishes near 0% at Layer29-32. The dark-blue line with square markers (RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit) begins near −1% at Layer1-4, declines to about −5.5% at Layer5-12, reaches its lowest point around −15% at Layer13-20, rises to about −11% at Layer21-28, and ends around −2% at Layer29-32.
